rater: AI-applied lexical rubric (this study); not a human rating

fields.detect: No section of the record identifies an authority for the exception.
fields.reflect: A later reviewer may be unable to determine who authorised the exception.
fields.correct: What record identifies the authority for this exception?
fields.learn: Add an authority-source field to the exception template.

fields.detect: The stated exception has no verified authority source linked in the record.
fields.reflect: A later reviewer may be unable to locate the authority the record relies on.
fields.correct: What record identifies the authority for this exception, and where can it be located?
fields.learn: Add an authority-source field with a document identifier and date.

fields.detect: No compensating control is stated in the record.
fields.reflect: A later reviewer cannot see what limited the exposure while the exception was open.
fields.correct: What compensating controls, if any, does the record identify for this access?
fields.learn: Add a compensating-controls field with a source reference.

fields.detect: No expiry date is stated for the exception.
fields.reflect: Without an end point a later reviewer cannot tell when the exception was expected to close.
fields.correct: What event or date would trigger renewal, expiry, or reassessment?
fields.learn: Require an expiry date and a renewal condition in the template.

fields.detect: No explicitly dated event appears in the record.
fields.reflect: The sequence of events that led to the decision cannot be reconstructed.
fields.correct: What dates establish the sequence of events that led to the decision?
fields.learn: Ask for a date for each step the record describes.

fields.detect: No sentence states the decision or conclusion.
fields.reflect: A later reviewer cannot identify what is being reconstructed.
fields.correct: Which passage records the decision or conclusion?
fields.learn: Add a decision statement to the record template.

fields.detect: A decision is stated with no linked basis section.
fields.reflect: A later reviewer may not be able to see what the decision rested on.
fields.correct: What record states the basis for this decision?
fields.learn: Pair the decision field with a basis field.

fields.detect: A decision is stated with no linked basis section.
fields.reflect: A later reviewer may not be able to trace how the decision was reached.
fields.correct: What record states the basis for this decision?
fields.learn: Pair the decision field with a basis field.

fields.detect: A basis is stated with no linked decision.
fields.reflect: A later reviewer may not be able to tell what the basis was used for.
fields.correct: Which passage records the decision this basis relates to?
fields.learn: Pair the basis field with a decision field.

fields.detect: The basis section states neither a reason nor a source reference.
fields.reflect: A later reviewer may not be able to see why the exception was considered.
fields.correct: What reason or source does the record give for the exception?
fields.learn: Add a source-reference field to the basis section.

fields.detect: Two verified record spans provide incompatible decision dates.
fields.reflect: The sequence cannot be reconstructed without clarification.
fields.correct: Which date reflects the actual decision, and what record confirms it?
fields.learn: Require a single decision-date field and source reference.

fields.detect: Two dated record spans appear in an order that cannot both be correct as written.
fields.reflect: The sequence cannot be reconstructed without clarification.
fields.correct: What date establishes the decision sequence, and which source document records it?
fields.learn: Add a date check between request, decision and expiry fields.

fields.detect: The record states the authority as given in one passage and as pending in another.
fields.reflect: A later reviewer cannot tell the authority status from the record alone.
fields.correct: What record shows the authority status at the time of the decision?
fields.learn: Add an authority-status field with a date.

fields.detect: A control is stated as in place in one passage and as not in place in another.
fields.reflect: A later reviewer cannot tell which controls applied from the record alone.
fields.correct: What record shows whether this control was in place, and from what date?
fields.learn: Add an implementation-date field for each control.

fields.detect: The record states the risk as low in one passage and as unresolved or high in another.
fields.reflect: A later reviewer cannot tell which risk statement the decision relied on.
fields.correct: What evidence links the stated risk to the requested access, and which risk statement does the record rely on?
fields.learn: Add a single risk field with its source.

fields.detect: Two quotations cited for the same assertion state incompatible values.
fields.reflect: A later reviewer cannot tell which statement the record relies on.
fields.correct: Which statement does the record rely on, and what record confirms it?
fields.learn: Use one field per fact so the record states it once.

fields.detect: A proposed quotation occurs more than once in the record and could not be located uniquely.
fields.reflect: A reviewer cannot tell which passage the observation refers to.
fields.correct: Which occurrence of this text does the observation refer to?
fields.learn: Prefer distinctive wording in fields that are quoted.

fields.detect: A proposed quotation does not occur in the record.
fields.reflect: An observation that rests on text outside the record cannot be checked.
fields.correct: What passage of the record, if any, does this observation rely on?
fields.learn: Keep cited material inside the record or reference it by identifier.

fields.detect: A risk assessment is dated after the decision it is linked to.
fields.reflect: A later reviewer cannot tell whether the assessment informed the decision.
fields.correct: On what date was the risk assessment completed, and which record confirms it?
fields.learn: Add a date check between the assessment and decision fields.

fields.detect: Two record spans state different expiry dates.
fields.reflect: A later reviewer cannot tell when the exception was expected to close.
fields.correct: Which expiry date applies, and which record confirms it?
fields.learn: Use a single expiry-date field.

fields.detect: The stated grant duration does not match the stated decision and expiry dates.
fields.reflect: A later reviewer cannot tell which period the exception covered.
fields.correct: Which period does the record intend, and which record confirms the dates?
fields.learn: Derive the duration from the decision and expiry fields.

fields.detect: No dated decision appears in the record.
fields.reflect: The sequence that ends in the decision cannot be reconstructed.
fields.correct: On what date was the decision made, and which record states it?
fields.learn: Add a decision-date field to the template.

fields.detect: A record span uses absolute or certainty terms.
fields.reflect: Absolute terms state a confidence the record may not show the basis for.
fields.correct: What evidence in the record supports the stated degree of certainty?
fields.learn: List certainty terms that prompt a request for the supporting measurement.

fields.detect: No identifiable evidence (a dated, numbered, identified or on-file source) for the conclusion appears in the record.
fields.reflect: A later reviewer cannot see what the conclusion rested on.
fields.correct: Which document, date or measurement in the record does the conclusion rest on?
fields.learn: Add a field that names the evidence each conclusion rests on.

fields.detect: The record cites an authority but states no facts showing how its conditions were met.
fields.reflect: A citation of a rule does not show which facts satisfied it.
fields.correct: Which facts in the record meet the conditions of the cited authority?
fields.learn: Pair each cited authority with the facts that meet its conditions.

fields.detect: The stated reason repeats the conclusion instead of giving a separate basis.
fields.reflect: A reason that restates the outcome does not show how the outcome was reached.
fields.correct: What separate fact or source does the record give for this conclusion?
fields.learn: Ask for each reason to name a fact or source other than the outcome itself.

fields.detect: A decision is stated without any reason or source.
fields.reflect: A later reviewer cannot trace how the decision was reached.
fields.correct: What reason or source does the record give for this decision?
fields.learn: Pair each decision with a stated reason and its source.

fields.detect: A conclusion in the record has no identifiable evidence of its own.
fields.reflect: A conclusion without its own basis cannot be checked from the record.
fields.correct: Which passage of the record supports this conclusion?
fields.learn: Give each conclusion its own basis reference.

fields.detect: The record gives one event two different dates.
fields.reflect: The sequence cannot be reconstructed without clarification.
fields.correct: Which date applies to this event, and which record confirms it?
fields.learn: Record each event date once, with its source.

fields.detect: The record states opposite outcomes for the same item.
fields.reflect: A later reviewer cannot tell which outcome the record relies on.
fields.correct: Which outcome applies to this item, and which record confirms it?
fields.learn: Record one outcome per item, with its reference.
